lm_output: "Carlos Fonseca" explained to him, the original had been lost, so they decided to look for the one closest to the sequence —taken a second before or after the other— to replace it. "It was almost the same, only in this one I had a lost look," he recommended, referring to the advice given in Desiderius Erasmus' works "De copia" and "De ratio studii." His method was to make notes on whatever he was reading, categorized by theme: he carted these commonplaces in boxes that accompanied him. When assembling a new book, he would go through the topics and cross out commonplace notes as he used them.
